what_this_is: Disposition of every row in the reviewed cohort. Counts only: no amount and no refused figure appears here or anywhere else in this repository.
cohort_definition: Fee-collection observations in the frozen research input that had already passed the research project's mechanical validation checks, with measure type total_fees_collected, gross_residential_fees_collected or mixed_or_unallocated_fees_collected.
note: Every refusal carries its own source-specific reason naming the document, the page and the defect. Those reasons are retained privately with the held rows; only the reason codes and counts are published, in refusals-by-reason.csv.
